description: Bandwise Gate: done-check on Stop and action-risk-gate on PreToolUse, through hosted Bandwise only. Each command clears the System One provider keys for its own process, so without BANDWISE_TOKEN each hook ends silently and never calls a provider on a key from your shell.

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && TYPESAFE_API_KEY= OPENROUTER_API_KEY= AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY= npx -y @bandwise/cli@0.4.0 hook Stop --set "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/sets/done-check.json"

cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && TYPESAFE_API_KEY= OPENROUTER_API_KEY= AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY= npx -y @bandwise/cli@0.4.0 hook PreToolUse --set "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/sets/action-risk-gate.json" --drop content_preview
